emailSubject: FMB News | Magnitude 5.8 Quake Hits Off Occidental Mindoro | August 7, 2026 | 12:00 PM PHT
headline: Phivolcs Revises Occidental Mindoro Earthquake to Magnitude 5.4
deck: Phivolcs revised the offshore Occidental Mindoro earthquake from an initial magnitude 5.8 to magnitude 5.4 and placed it 13 kilometers southwest of Mamburao.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: A magnitude 5.4 tectonic earthquake struck offshore near Mamburao, Occidental Mindoro, at 10:38 AM on August 7, 2026. Phivolcs initially measured the event at magnitude 5.8 before revising its parameters.
The earthquake was felt across parts of Mindoro, Southern Luzon and Metro Manila.

sections.heading: What we know
paragraphs: Phivolcs located the revised earthquake 13 kilometers southwest of Mamburao at a depth of 14 kilometers.
Intensity 5 shaking was reported in Mamburao and several localities in Oriental Mindoro. Lower intensities were recorded in Batangas, Cavite, Laguna, Quezon City and other areas.
Damage was not expected, but Phivolcs said aftershocks were possible.

sections.heading: Background
paragraphs: Earthquake magnitudes and locations can be revised after seismologists receive and analyze additional station data. The initial 5.8 estimate and the later 5.4 measurement refer to the same event, not two separate earthquakes.

sections.heading: What remains unclear
paragraphs: Local authorities may continue checking buildings and infrastructure for minor effects. Any confirmed damage or injuries would require separate validation from disaster officials.

sections.heading: Why this matters to Filipinos
paragraphs: Clear updates prevent an initial earthquake estimate from circulating as the final measurement. Residents should rely on the latest Phivolcs bulletin and follow local safety instructions during aftershocks.

sections.heading: What happens next
paragraphs: Phivolcs will continue recording aftershocks and may issue further information if the event parameters or reported intensities change.
